Today, I had the opportunity to visit again. The female doctor seemed knowledgeable enough to be trusted, but her demeanor and speech were not professional. She was comparable to a market vendor with supposed veterinary knowledge. While her verbal skills might seem sophisticated given her upbringing, as an educated individual, I can see through her. I believe she needs significant improvement in her attitude and service approach to meet professional standards.

I am disappointed and have lost the positive feelings I once had for this clinic. I will not be returning or recommending it to anyone in my vicinity.

text:
My pet died.
I've brought my pet here several times before. Vaccinations, medication, eye drops, and consultations were all done well at this clinic.
However, this time I brought my pet from a veterinary hospital to this clinic because the cages were full. I asked the vet and they said I could bring my pet in. I trusted the vet, but after leaving my pet there for less than 12 hours, its condition worsened significantly. In the morning, the pet was awake and conscious, but seeing its condition, I knew it had been neglected for some time. By the time I tried to fix the problem, it was too late.
The vet told me to take my pet to the emergency room, and the emergency room's diagnosis of death differed from the vet's assessment.
This incident made me think for a long time whether I should write about it. Ultimately, if the clinic or the vet are not skilled/experienced/unprepared for the animal's care, they should have stated this from the beginning, during the assessment, for the benefit of both parties.

The anesthesia and treatment costs were very reasonable compared to other places.
You can inquire about pricing beforehand.
The vet and nurses were friendly and transparent.

Wound cleaning solution, cotton swabs, and antibiotics/anti-inflammatory medication were provided free of charge!

Importantly, follow-up wound checks and cleanings were also free of charge.

(This case involved a male cat being neutered.) This was very surprising, as other places usually charge for this service.

I was so impressed that I felt compelled to write a genuine review to express my gratitude. I will definitely use their services again, as I have several cats at home.
